transitions.reason: requestMint has updateEpoch modifier; transitionEpoch is called first on every requestMint invocation
After epoch N closes (transitionEpoch increments currentEpoch), SETTER_ADMIN can set epoch N exchange rate. epochToSet must be < currentEpoch.
claimMint requires epochToExchangeRate[epochToClaim] != 0; setMintExchangeRate is the only non-override way to set it. This is the core mint lifecycle path.
User receives CASH via claimMint, then can call requestRedemption to burn CASH and queue redemption in current epoch.
After epoch closes, MANAGER_ADMIN calls completeRedemptions to distribute collateral to redeemers. Requires epochToService < currentEpoch.
Multiple requestMint calls in same epoch accumulate in mintRequestsPerEpoch[epoch][user] (+=). Limit: mintLimit per epoch.
MANAGER_ADMIN can bypass delta check and set any exchange rate for any past epoch via overrideExchangeRate.
setMintExchangeRate auto-pauses if |newRate - lastSetMintExchangeRate| > deltaLimit bps. pause is a side effect, not a separate call.
MANAGER_ADMIN calls unpause to resume operations after pause (auto or manual).
Standard ERC20 approval flow; approve sets transferAllowances[src][spender], transferFrom consumes it. Applies to both CASH token and cToken.
Multiple transferFrom calls possible within allowance; allowance decrements each time.
setPrice requires fTokenToOracleType[fToken] == MANUAL; setFTokenToOracleType(MANUAL) must precede setPrice.
setPrice writes fTokenToUnderlyingPrice[fToken]; getUnderlyingPrice reads it for MANUAL oracle type. This is the primary oracle read path in harness.
Oracle price manipulation → Comptroller liquidity check fails → liquidation enabled → seize transfers cTokens from borrower to liquidator. Requires lending market wiring (coverage phase).
cToken mint deposits underlying, mints cTokens as collateral. borrow uses collateral value (via oracle) to determine borrowing capacity. Standard Compound supply->borrow sequence.
If oracle price falls or rate rises, borrower becomes undercollateralized; liquidator calls liquidateBorrow which calls seize on the collateral cToken.
borrow calls accrueInterest first; borrowIndex and totalBorrows updated before new borrow is recorded.
mint calls accrueInterest first (via mintInternal); ensures exchange rate is up-to-date before minting new cTokens.
requestMint requires checkKYC(msg.sender); addKYCAddresses must have been called for msg.sender in the correct group before requestMint can succeed.
removeKYCAddresses revokes KYC; subsequent requestMint for that address will revert with KYCCheckFailed.
After claimMint, user has CASH; they may approve the CashManager or a cToken market to spend CASH. Enables requestRedemption or cToken deposit.
After receiving collateral from completeRedemptions, a user may re-enter the protocol by calling requestMint in a new epoch.
setPriceCap sets fTokenToUnderlyingPriceCap[fToken]; getUnderlyingPrice returns min(price, cap) when cap > 0.
Multiple requestRedemption calls in same epoch accumulate addressToBurnAmt and totalBurned. Each call burns CASH immediately.
Changing deltaLimit alters when auto-pause fires in setMintExchangeRate. Setting to 0 means any non-equal rate triggers pause; setting to 10000 means no auto-pause.
